heroHeadline: Russia Strikes Kyiv Power Plant as Trump Vows to Broker Peace Deal Between Zelensky and Putin
heroSubtitle: President Zelensky condemned the strike on a key Kyiv power plant and again said allies gave no advance warning — as US President Trump pledged to broker a peace deal between Kyiv and Moscow amid mounting diplomatic pressure.
